content_sections.title: A short station story
content_sections.body_text: At 5:10, Mai was reading the station board when Linh called. Linh needed the bus number, time, and gate. Board: ‘Bus 12 leaves at 5:20 from Gate 4.’ Read the story, cover it, and name the action in progress and the three board facts.

content_sections.title: Choose a suitable request
content_sections.body_text: To unfamiliar staff: ‘Excuse me. Could you help me check the 5:20 departure and find Gate 4, please?’ To a friend beside you: ‘Can you check Gate 4 with me?’ The first suits a respectful request to staff; the second suits a small shared task with a friend. Now choose one form for each person, say why it fits, and adapt the time, place, or detail. In urgent danger, get attention and state the need directly.

content_sections.title: Pass the answer to Linh
content_sections.body_text: Linh: ‘Which bus is it, and where do I go?’ Mai: ‘Bus 12 leaves at 5:20 from Gate 4.’ Linh: ‘Thanks.’ Mai read one source, asked staff, then gave Linh the needed facts. Cover the board, answer Linh, and uncover it to check bus 12, 5:20, and Gate 4.

content_sections.title: Stress STA and check by listening
content_sections.body_text: STA-tion has two beats; STA /steɪ/ is stronger. Keep /eɪ/ clear and say the second beat lightly. Record the story and both talks. Hide the text, replay, and write: What was Mai doing? What did staff say? What did Mai tell Linh? Uncover the model and check every answer and the three matching facts.
